customer: Honestly, this is getting ridiculous. I moved my business to Dunmore last year but my station wagon is still registered in my old state, and I just want to know if you'll even buy it or if I'm wasting another afternoon. What do I actually need to bring?
agent: I'm sorry for the hassle, and the good news is that we buy cars registered in any state we serve, even if you now live in a different one. Just bring the registration from the state that issued it. If the title happens to be lost, the duplicate rules of the issuing state apply, and our article "Selling a paid-off car when the title is lost" covers that.
